caption: The drawing shows a rectangular mirror with a decorative frame. The frame is brown and features ornate, symmetrical scrollwork at the top, sides, and bottom, giving it a classic, vintage appearance. The top center of the frame is adorned with a green, leaf-like motif. The reflective surface of the mirror is colored light blue with irregular white streaks, suggesting the mirrored glass. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects present in the composition.
title: Mirror
